column1: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL db-g1-small (1.7 GB) zonal
column8: PostgreSQL, NOT MySQL. Terraform default db-f1-micro (0.6 GB) cannot build pgvector HNSW indexes. g1-small is the honest floor; see README failure modes.
SSD not HDD: pgvector similarity scans are latency-sensitive. Terraform default disk_type=PD_HDD is wrong for vector search.
Backups on. Restore-from-backup is the only recovery path at this tier.
